GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up half off, joined in passing 200m, joint lead 100m, kept on strong , headed late # had run/almost
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out and bumped with another runner over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly missing start 1 length , worked up out Wide and trailed 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked wider Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. # slow out then Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced three wide, without over, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Rolled fwd before raced Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead) early . Worked to improve 1 length midrace & Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken @ 400m & pushed along =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pressured & tried to sprint with winner @ 200m. Weakened in last 150m. # Wide/never likely.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered straight to the outside fence, Made Good Ground down the outside in Straight # just missed
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length on fence, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, Hooked Out 3 Wide Straightening Up and Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m was steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 1-2l off 4 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, all clear, kept on one pace # 4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout. Laid in whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Five Wide in the early upfront scramble, trailed marginally Five Wide turning, steered one lane past centre of track Straightening Up , kept trying in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # wide/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, plodded home # weak run home
Jumped Well sat box seat 2 Lengths off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported when he felt there was something amiss with the gelding, he eased it down over the final 200m. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr rep subsequently reported a thorough vet exam of the gelding failed to detect any issues that would have caused it to perform poorly. Tnr rep was advised the gelding will be required to barrier trial prior to racing again. Since passed trial at Coffs Harbour 8/5/26.
